title: Normalized level ranking reward definition (legacy level_ranking_reward domain)
description: Contract for one normalized level ranking reward: one stored legacy level_ranking_reward entry. The stored integer level is the stable identity, so legacy_id is its decimal form (rule E2); cash and the units map are kept verbatim native values (rule E1), and every units key must resolve against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule E3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored level_ranking_reward level preserved verbatim as a string (rule E2): the decimal form of the native integer level.

kind.description: Classification of the stored level_ranking_reward domain: every entry maps to level_ranking_reward.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets level_ranking_reward).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets level_ranking_reward).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

level.description: Native stored ranking level, kept verbatim; rows cover 50..1 exactly once (rule E1).

cash.description: Native stored cash reward, kept verbatim (rule E1).

units.description: Native stored units reward map of item-id keys to integer quantities, kept verbatim; every key must resolve against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rules E1/E3).

unit_refs.description: Resolved cross-domain item references: the units map keys as legacy_id strings in sorted order, each validated against the normalized items legacy-ID set (rule E3).
